incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: checkout spans oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder are recorded as failures with status_tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' on trace ids 486c8b61cc911ee1bda647b10161cfed (span 56e0b012988ff3d3, 14463 us), d2ee2fa01a77bc612dc3b2c8ed19364e (span 2c6ab1c2a3eb582f, 8597 us), d911a67e1320b590c91d98901b12337f (span 4e9d9b4a2fd3526a, 8597 us) and e4c58087303cc409fb52da511f7a38e4 (span 6d24419690ac5947, 5279 us).

In the same four traces, checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge on service checkout is marked error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2 with otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (spans 546acd433d0aed04, 64772c80026859d6, ff6c6d76aae7c12f, 3eb74a2653fa1c42), i.e. the failing checkout call is its Charge call to payment.

The payment service's own server spans grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge fail for the same trace ids (d2ee2fa01a77bc612dc3b2c8ed19364e span 23f47960175d0058, 486c8b61cc911ee1bda647b10161cfed span 50f7e8b230f35d31, d911a67e1320b590c91d98901b12337f span f9516e938e34a1e7, e4c58087303cc409fb52da511f7a38e4 span 074d1b7904666260) with error=true and otel.status_code=ERROR, grpc.error_name 'Error', grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and exception.stacktrace originating at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) via chargeServiceHandler (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22). Durations were 478-2364 us.

Payment also served successful grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in the same 5-minute window, e.g. trace ids 2349ef2bdab435e69a72ce402dd76a62 (5143 us), e67c8c779caa460849d331532eec048d (2452 us), 66fdd1bb3fb3ae6fee8b2902e5f7ad42 (2231 us), a5debbcfd60be6aa4f6cbd2636019d16 (1895 us) and 5b530bfc22c78bb41c469a488e723e58 (2021 us), so the Charge failures are intermittent, not a total outage of payment in this sample.

The failure propagates to the caller side with its own error spans: in trace 486c8b61cc911ee1bda647b10161cfed the frontend span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (dc98b906f9338864) and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' (480a40ac17f667d3) and 'POST /api/checkout' (a8650b94b64bd8a9) are error=true with http.status_code=500, as are frontend-proxy 'ingress' (0f1050128b179bf4) and 'router frontend egress' (6ad634c4038d6fa5) and load-generator 'POST' (a8df85dd6a9bfc49); the same 500 pattern repeats in traces d2ee2fa01a77bc612dc3b2c8ed19364e, d911a67e1320b590c91d98901b12337f and e4c58087303cc409fb52da511f7a38e4.

product-catalog was checked and shows no failure: 9 spans in the 19:32:19-19:34:19 window (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and /ListProducts) all have rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations 17-332 us, and checkout's client ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans in the checkout sample are also rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (312-1050 us).

email was checked and shows no failure: in trace 66fdd1bb3fb3ae6fee8b2902e5f7ad42, email spans 'POST /send_order_confirmation' (http.status_code=200, 8270 us), 'send_email' (6263 us) and two 'sinatra.render_template' spans (2519 us, 1043 us) carry no error tags, and that whole trace completed with PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and frontend 'POST /api/checkout' http.status_code=200.

cart was checked and shows no failure: cart spans 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart', HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean all have 0 error rows (flagd rpc.grpc.status_code=0), and checkout's client spans oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (505-1791 us) and /EmptyCart (3224-4793 us) are rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

currency was checked and shows no failure: currency spans 'Currency/Convert' carry status_tags otel.status_code=OK and rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (239-1396 us), and checkout's client CurrencyService/Convert spans are rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (633-1861 us).

shipping was checked and shows no failure: shipping spans oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (1193, 2445, 10110 us) and oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder (41 us) have rpc.grpc.status_code=0, shipping 'POST' spans have http.status_code=200, and checkout's client GetQuote spans are rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (1431-12611 us); the related quote service spans ('POST /getquote', 'calculate-quote') show no error rows.

Observed latency values without a baseline: failing checkout PlaceOrder spans were 5279-14463 us while successful PlaceOrder spans in the same sample were 32056-58115 us (e.g. trace 2349ef2bdab435e69a72ce402dd76a62 58115 us, 66fdd1bb3fb3ae6fee8b2902e5f7ad42 57388 us); failing payment Charge spans were 478-2364 us versus 1895-5143 us for successful ones. No comparable baseline period was queried, so no latency trend is asserted.

Likely cause of the reported checkout errors: the payment service's Charge handler rejects the charge request with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (thrown at charge.js:37), and checkout surfaces that as gRPC code 13 'failed to charge card'. The failure originates inside payment's charge logic, not in a further dependency of payment; the only payment-side dependency span seen in these traces, grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat, completed with rpc.grpc.status_code=0.

Open sub-question, not resolved by this evidence: whether the 'Invalid token' rejection is limited to a particular card/token or customer attribute (the message carries app.loyalty.level=gold, and the same window contains successful Charge calls), e.g. a deliberately injected invalid-token payment failure rather than a resource or latency problem. Error text alone does not identify the trigger condition.

Rejected as the cause of the checkout errors: failure or elevated latency in checkout's other dependencies product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping or email. In the sampled traces covering the same window these services' own spans show no error rows (grpc status 0 / http 200) and sub-millisecond to ~12 ms durations, while the failing traces fail specifically at PaymentService/Charge.

Checkout is not failing on every order: successful PlaceOrder traces with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and frontend 'POST /api/checkout' http.status_code=200 exist in the same window, e.g. trace 66fdd1bb3fb3ae6fee8b2902e5f7ad42 (PlaceOrder 57388 us, payment Charge grpc 0, email confirmation 200) and trace 2349ef2bdab435e69a72ce402dd76a62 (58115 us, Charge grpc 0, CartService/EmptyCart grpc 0); this limits any claim that payment or checkout was wholly down.

The trace views are biased samples, not failure rates: the checkout search returned 369 spans of which only a 60-row slice was read, the payment search slice is similarly partial, and spans_omitted/spans_shown notes state that sampled-out spans are unknown. Therefore error counts here (four failing checkout traces, four failing payment Charge spans) are counts within the shown rows, not a measured error rate for the window.

gaps: Prometheus metrics were unavailable for the whole Run: metrics_range_query (twice), get_metric_names and get_label_values all returned status error with reason SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE (e.g. operation_ids 736a2256-4df6-47a1-b2a3-9d00e727405e-t1, 086d6df1-0468-4c00-847c-208923ec855b-t0, 3874d8bb-e318-4e8b-9736-b184948d93ed-t1, fac0bbdf-0920-4bf5-ace2-9c2af45b9f16-t1, add8c88a-459c-4441-bbd8-95dde314aefd-t0). No traces_span_metrics_calls_total error-rate series, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds series or http_server_request_duration_seconds series could be read, so metric-level error rates, latency histograms and baselines for checkout, payment and the other dependencies remain unknown (not zero).

Trace evidence is a projected, biased sample: traces_search results for checkout and payment were truncated to slices (60 of 369 spans, 50 of 369 spans), so the complete trace graph, per-operation failure rates and the full set of affected requests are unknown.

No latency baseline period was queried (the authorized window and the 5-minute scope requested contain only the incident period), so whether checkout or payment latency is elevated relative to normal cannot be determined.

Integrations kubernetes_state, pod_logs and change_history are not integrated in this Run, so pod restarts, container config changes and log-level detail for payment's 'Invalid token' branch could not be inspected.

Frontend checkouts not captured in the sampled traces, and the exact trigger condition inside payment's charge.js:37 token validation (e.g. a specific card token or injected fault value) are not observable from the returned spans.

Review payment's charge.js token validation path (Payment request failed. Invalid token.) and any feature-flag/fault-injection configuration that could make Charge reject requests for particular card tokens, since the failing spans show a flagd ResolveFloat evaluation on the payment path succeeding.

report_parsed.summary: Checkout's elevated errors are visible in traces as oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans with otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, whose otel.status_description is 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (trace ids 486c8b61cc911ee1bda647b10161cfed, d2ee2fa01a77bc612dc3b2c8ed19364e, d911a67e1320b590c91d98901b12337f, e4c58087303cc409fb52da511f7a38e4). The deepest service whose own spans fail is payment: its server spans grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carry grpc.error_name=Error, grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and an exception stacktrace in module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37) for the same four trace ids. Checkout's other dependencies were checked and show no failures in the sampled traces: product-catalog (all GetProduct/ListProducts rpc.grpc.status_code=0), cart (GetCart/EmptyCart/redis/flagd spans, 0 error rows), currency (Currency/Convert otel.status_code=OK), shipping (GetQuote/ShipOrder grpc 0, http 200) and email (POST /send_order_confirmation http 200). Payment also completed Charge successfully in several traces in the same window, so the failure is intermittent rather than total. Prometheus was unavailable throughout this Run (every metrics_range_query, get_metric_names and get_label_values call returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so no error-rate or latency series could be obtained; no latency trend is claimed because no comparable baseline exists.
